## Instructions

1. Cook dates with water and sugar until thick. Cool.
2. Mix the dry crumb ingredients and rub in the butter.
3. Press half into a greased pan.
4. Spread the dates and top with the rest of the crumbs.
5. Bake at 325°F, 30 minutes. Cut when cool.

## Notes

Always on the tray at church teas.
